## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) Xuánzàng is the second Chinese version of the *Smaller Sukhāvatīvyūhasūtra*, parallel to [Kumārajīva's T0366](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0082). Xuánzàng's translation, while more philologically faithful to the Sanskrit, never displaced Kumārajīva's older, stylistically more polished version in liturgical practice.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) Xuánzàng's Cháng'ān period (645 – 664 CE).

The Taishō text (T0367) is established on the standard apparatus.
